reviews.name: Sample Student A.
reviews.body: The finance subjects are challenging but very practical. Our Credit and Collection and Capital Markets classes used real Philippine cases.

reviews.name: Sample Student B.
reviews.body: Business Plan Implementation is where everything clicked. We ran an actual food stall on campus for a whole semester.

reviews.name: Sample Student C.
reviews.body: The professors know the industry well. I wish there were more digital marketing electives, but E-Commerce and Internet Marketing was great.

reviews.name: Sample Student D.
reviews.body: It's heavy on accounting, but the structure is clear and the faculty really push you. JPAMA activities are a highlight.

reviews.name: Sample Student E.
reviews.body: Recruitment and Selection and Labor Relations gave me confidence going into my internship at a BPO HR department.

reviews.name: Sample Student F.
reviews.body: I came from STEM, and the bridging subjects helped me catch up quickly. Classmates and teachers are very welcoming.

testimonials.quote: CBA taught me that numbers tell stories, and that integrity is what makes people trust the story you tell.
testimonials.name: Sample Alumnus

testimonials.quote: I started my business plan in third year. Today it employs six people in my hometown.
testimonials.name: Sample Alumna

testimonials.quote: The 600-hour internship opened the door to my first job before I even graduated.
testimonials.name: Sample Graduate

campaigns.title: Town Hall Meeting

campaigns.title: Enrollment for SY 2027–2028 is open
campaigns.body: Secure your slot in any of our six business programs. Pre-register online and visit New Valentine Hall for advising.

campaigns.title: Not from ABM? Try our Bridging Program
campaigns.body: STEM, HUMSS, GAS and TVL graduates can take BSBA Business Management or Financial Management through our Bridging curricula.

campaigns.title: CBA Week 2026
campaigns.body: Business quiz bowls, marketing pitch battles, an entrepreneurship bazaar, and the CBA intramurals at the CPU Gym.

campaigns.title: Open Campus Day for Senior High Students
campaigns.body: Tour the College, sit in a sample class, and meet our student organizations.
